Eat right and enough, professional staff
Aug 2026 • Friends
Our group has eight people, so if the kitchen comes up at the same time, there is no room to eat. What I like about HK Beer Duy Tân is that it comes in fairly reasonable turns. While everyone is about to finish the first meal, the next one is brought up. Beer is always brought out very quickly every time you call. There was a friend in the group who accidentally poured out a glass of water, and when he couldn’t get up, the staff carried a towel and assisted in cleaning. The details are small but make the whole table feel very professional.
